description: Use when the user wants an AI employee team to stop for now, or to start again (teamId from list_teams). Pausing stops every member from starting runs and cancels runs in progress; work waiting for approval stays. The subscription keeps billing while paused: say so. resume: true resumes only what the team paused (a member paused on its own stays paused), and is refused, with what to do, while the team waits for payment, its subscription is inactive or its monthly work limit is reached. Only the person who launched the team or a workspace admin can. No cost to call.
name: pause_team

outputSchema.description: The team after the change: its status and members.
